bot.description: The binding's name; may be omitted when the caller owns exactly one.

media_id.description: The id in an inbound message's image, audio, video, document or sticker object.

destination.description: Optional directory reference, e.g. dlfs/imports or file://inbox (trailing slash optional). Uses caller write authority. Omit for the binding owner's private DLFS whatsapp drive.

fileName.description: Optional safe basename, not a path (at most 200 UTF-8 bytes), such as a document's own filename. Conflicts receive a numeric suffix without added spaces.

name: Download WhatsApp media
description: Downloads the media of an inbound WhatsApp message by its media id: the id is looked up and its short-lived link fetched with the binding's token. Returns ref, fileName (the stored name), media_id and size, with contentType when known. Meta does not return a filename, so without fileName the name comes from the binding and the media id; conflicts use report(1).pdf, report(2).pdf, etc., and files are never overwritten. Omit destination for the binding owner's private DLFS whatsapp drive; reading the file there needs the owner's authority. Explicit directories use caller write authority and a content provider supporting create-only writes (DLFS or configured file roots). Requires whatsapp/download on the binding; whatsapp/send does not grant it. Maximum 20 MiB; no token-bearing URL is returned.
